scope: Cumulative prior research register; preserve original reading/access qualifications. Includes background material not implemented. Not a register of profitable strategies.

initial_and_global.title: Renaissance Technologies official firm overview
initial_and_global.use: Established mathematical and systematic research context. No reproducible Medallion alpha was disclosed in the reviewed material.

initial_and_global.title: Inside EQR What It Means to Work in Alpha Research
initial_and_global.use: Motivated testing forecasts through implementation and live economics. No proprietary signal was copied.

initial_and_global.title: Trading Research and Technology Overview
initial_and_global.use: Established liquidity provision, market mechanics and machine learning context. Daily stock strategies do not replicate market making.

initial_and_global.title: Machine Teaching What I Learned From My Optimizer
initial_and_global.use: Motivated inspecting portfolio objectives and unintended optimization behavior. It did not supply a disclosed trading strategy.

initial_and_global.title: Time Series Momentum
initial_and_global.authors: Tobias Moskowitz Yao Hua Ooi Lasse Pedersen
initial_and_global.use: Motivated absolute trend. Our long-only ETF rules differ from the paper's futures and forward excess-return strategy.

initial_and_global.title: Value and Momentum Everywhere
initial_and_global.authors: Clifford Asness Tobias Moskowitz Lasse Pedersen
initial_and_global.use: Motivated combining different return drivers. Price momentum does not implement fundamental value.

initial_and_global.title: Quality Minus Junk
initial_and_global.authors: Clifford Asness Andrea Frazzini Lasse Pedersen
initial_and_global.use: Identified a possible distinct quality sleeve. Point-in-time fundamentals and release timestamps are needed before implementation.

initial_and_global.title: Trading Costs
initial_and_global.authors: Andrea Frazzini Ronen Israel Tobias Moskowitz
initial_and_global.use: Motivated net performance and impact sensitivity. Institution-specific empirical calibration is not verified broker execution for this account.

initial_and_global.title: Improving Trade Execution Systematically
initial_and_global.use: Motivated implementation shortfall, trading-activity benchmarks and sufficient measured fills. Current simulations remain estimates.

initial_and_global.title: Is Factor Momentum More than Stock Momentum
initial_and_global.use: Motivated checking signal overlap. Trend and relative momentum should not be counted as independent sources of alpha.

initial_and_global.title: Enhancing Time Series Momentum Strategies Using Deep Neural Networks
initial_and_global.authors: Bryan Lim Stefan Zohren Stephen Roberts
initial_and_global.use: Examines joint learning of trends and position sizing with turnover regularization. No neural network was implemented and no production Man AHL model was inferred.

initial_and_global.title: The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
initial_and_global.authors: David Bailey Jonathan Borwein Marcos Lopez de Prado Qiji Jim Zhu
initial_and_global.use: Motivated trial logs and separating exploration from independent evaluation. Walk-forward chronology alone cannot remove researcher selection bias.

initial_and_global.title: Implementing Momentum What Have We Learned
initial_and_global.authors: Adrienne Ross Tobias Moskowitz Ronen Israel Laura Serban
initial_and_global.use: Motivated turnover control and equity momentum implementation. Our rules and universes require independent verification.

initial_and_global.title: yfinance documentation
initial_and_global.use: Supports Yahoo data retrieval mechanics. Data availability is distinct from broker tradability and does not supply historical membership.

initial_and_global.title: Residual Momentum
initial_and_global.authors: David Blitz Joop Huij Martin Martens
initial_and_global.use: Motivated separating stock-specific momentum from common-factor moves. Tested a market-only residual proxy, rather than the paper's Fama French factor specification.

initial_and_global.title: Honey I Shrunk the Sample Covariance Matrix
initial_and_global.use: Motivated stabilizing covariance estimates. The trial's fixed diagonal blend is a heuristic, not the optimized Ledoit Wolf estimator.

initial_and_global.title: Dynamic Trading With Predictable Returns and Transactions Costs
initial_and_global.use: Motivated retaining holdings and moving gradually toward new targets. A 50 percent blend is a research heuristic, not the paper's solved optimum.

initial_and_global.title: Volatility Managed Portfolios
initial_and_global.use: Motivated reducing risk when volatility rises. Our long-only risk budgets and weekly guard are adaptations and avoid leverage.

initial_and_global.title: On the performance of volatility managed portfolios
initial_and_global.authors: Scott Cederburg Michael O Doherty Feifei Wang Xuemin Yan
initial_and_global.use: Provides counterevidence to assuming volatility scaling improves implementable out-of-sample performance. Supports retaining plain baselines and rejecting failed refinements.

initial_and_global.title: Momentum Crashes
initial_and_global.use: Motivated stress and reversal analysis. Long-short momentum crash findings are not equivalent to the behavior of a long-only equity basket.

initial_and_global.title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio Correcting for Selection Bias Backtest Overfitting and Non Normality
initial_and_global.authors: David Bailey Marcos Lopez de Prado
initial_and_global.use: Motivated trial-aware evidence and the distinction between observed Sharpe and a statistically supported edge. Exact trial counting and family definitions still matter.

initial_and_global.title: Enhanced Portfolio Optimization
initial_and_global.use: Selected-name covariance regularization trial; simplified rank views and 50% diagonal shrinkage, not an exact EPO replication.

initial_and_global.title: Estimating Global Investor Views with Reverse Optimization
initial_and_global.use: Motivated explicit assumptions and a global benchmark anchor. Reverse optimization and implied global return forecasts are not implemented.

initial_and_global.title: The Numbers Are In Flexible Trading Helps Across Markets
initial_and_global.use: Motivated buffered retention and execution-cost awareness. Their observed price improvement is not credited to our fills.

initial_and_global.title: Global Portfolio Optimization
initial_and_global.use: Motivated an ACWI core and constrained deviations. No equilibrium return inference or confidence-weighted Black–Litterman posterior is implemented.

initial_and_global.title: Machine learning and portfolio optimization
initial_and_global.use: Supports regularization and independent validation. Full performance-based regularization and k-fold algorithm are not replicated; evaluation uses chronological annual selection.

initial_and_global.title: The Need for Speed in Trend Following Strategies
initial_and_global.use: Motivated responsiveness versus costs. Weekly equity stress cuts are a heuristic; they are not the paper’s multi-speed futures systems.

initial_and_global.title: ActiveBeta Investment Solution
initial_and_global.use: Motivated market-relative factor diversification and turnover controls. Quality and value deferred until dated global fundamental records exist.

initial_and_global.title: Factor Views 3Q 2026
initial_and_global.use: Considered diversification across factors and factor dispersion. Current tactical commentary is not used as a historical trading signal.

initial_and_global.title: Dynamic Multifactor
initial_and_global.use: Considered factor cyclicality and investability; proprietary macro indicators and fundamental factors are not inferred from price.

industry_options.title: Covering the World: Global Evidence on Covered Calls
industry_options.use_and_limits: Separate equity exposure, volatility exposure and timing; our spread overlay is not a replication.

industry_options.title: An Alternative Option to Portfolio Rebalancing
industry_options.use_and_limits: Compare overlay against identical underlying decisions. Single-stock premium evidence is weaker than index evidence.

industry_options.coverage: Paper reviewed in earlier research; official page rechecked
industry_options.use_and_limits: Adapt multi-horizon trend to a long-only core; not the published futures portfolio.

industry_options.use_and_limits: Budget option carry; do not assume permanent long-option protection improves growth.

industry_options.title: Factors
industry_options.use_and_limits: Carry differs across asset classes; no universal IV screen.

industry_options.title: Option pricing and hedging with minimum expected shortfall

industry_options.use_and_limits: Context for trend and convexity; not a replication of their variance strategy.

industry_options.title: US stocks are more volatile than you think
industry_options.use_and_limits: Index volatility cannot establish single-stock option mispricing; this dated observation is not a historical signal.

industry_options.title: GS Quant: Measures
industry_options.use_and_limits: Currency and instrument-specific units matter; no GS Quant API or proprietary alpha used.

industry_options.title: Do Financial Markets Reward Buying or Selling Insurance and Lottery Tickets?
industry_options.use_and_limits: Skew and insurance-premium context, not proof that these spreads earn alpha.

industry_options.use_and_limits: Direct futures options need futures deliverables and settlement; listed share proxies do not provide that capability.

further_options.title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
further_options.coverage: Official abstract/search extraction; PDF request failed
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Risk scaling motivation, not a replication of their inverse-variance factor portfolio.

further_options.authors_or_firm: Harvey, Hoyle, Korgaonkar, Rattray, Sargaison and Van Hemert; Duke/Man Group
further_options.title: The Impact of Volatility Targeting
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Fast/slow volatility guard. Effects differ by asset class; this code does not promise a volatility target or published performance.

further_options.title: Momentum Crashes
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Bearish momentum can lose sharply in rebounds; restrict bearish entry to a weak market without a sharp recent rebound. Threshold is our heuristic.

further_options.title: Trading Costs of Asset Pricing Anomalies
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Retain still-competitive core holdings, avoid unrelated option-roll core resets, score option costs. Not their execution optimizer or cost calibration.

further_options.title: Covered Call Strategies: One Fact and Eight Myths
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Do not equate premium receipts with alpha. Automatic covered-call income overlay not added.

further_options.title: Covered Calls and Their Unintended Reversal Bet
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Keep attribution between underlying risk, options and timing; not an implementation of their hedged covered-call portfolio.

further_options.authors_or_firm: Goyal and Saretto; Emory/Purdue author paper hosted by Rice
further_options.title: Cross-Section of Option Returns and Volatility
further_options.coverage: Introduction, data filters and trading-friction sections
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Volatility relative-value candidate requires actual historical option bid/ask and IV. Deferred; manufactured stock IV is not evidence of this edge.

further_options.title: Speculative Strategies with Treasury Options
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Bull calls and bear puts have bounded terminal debit-spread payoffs. Payoff geometry adapted; not direct Treasury futures option support.

further_options.title: Cboe S&P 500 Dispersion Index
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Dispersion requires index and constituent market option prices plus weights; deferred, not inferred from manufactured IV.

further_options.title: Improving portfolio diversification with option-based strategies
further_options.coverage: Official search excerpt; full page fetch failed
further_options.adaptation_and_limits: Collars exchange upside participation for protection. Not adopted as a default growth strategy or replicated product.
